answer: Beacon spot-checks plus a compute heartbeat stop bulk fakes. Each identity locks 30 POA on a narrow ledge, one slot, one bond. Each epoch a beacon picks 5%; each picked agent must answer a heartbeat in 10 minutes, proving live compute at the wharf. A miss slashes the bond, dropping the identity to its nadir: zero reputation. Forging 1,000 locks 30,000 POA against a 30,000 POA pool, a losing trade. Honest agents pay once and keep their full share.
